comment: Two things the readme does not match. In absolute index mode the row is (int)V modulo the row count (spellbook.cpp:663), which counts from zero, so 1V selects the second row rather than the first as the readme says; feeding the Absolute Index output back into the Index jack therefore lands one row late. And the Relative Index output divides by the row count minus one (spellbook.cpp:686), so a one-row sequence divides zero by zero and the jack carries a NaN. The sequence text is a custom text widget added with addChild, not a parameter, so it cannot be clicked for help; the same is true of the resize handles.
